messages.subject: Re: Error in geom_histogram
parts:
For whatever it's worth in debugging this,

qplot(c(-1e9,1e9),geom="histogram") ## works
qplot(c(-1e10,1e10),geom="histogram") ## fails

is a more easily reproducible example.

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Error in geom_histogram
parts:
Hi,

@ Trevor, you can get around this by specifying the binwidth argument.
Given the huge values you are working with, I would use a large
number (e.g., 10^5) or it could take a long time. Alternately, use
smaller numbers.

@ Dr. Bolker, thanks for the easy example.

I think this comes down to floating point precision issues for numbers
of this size in the default cutting/binning code. The actual test is
in position-collide.r ~~ line 40. Relaxing the test on the standard
deviation of the widths (xmax - xmin for each bar), also "fixes" the
problem.

Cheers,

Josh
